title: The quantifier-duality step negates the wrong formula name.
details: Kruckman, Model Theory Lecture Notes (2018-12-14), Theorem 6.25, implication (3)⇔(4), printed p.76. After choosing a universal formula ψ equivalent modulo T to ¬φ, the text says that φ is equivalent to ¬φ. The required formula is ¬ψ: negating ¬φ↔ψ gives φ↔¬ψ, and quantifier duality makes ¬ψ existential. This local name/negation slip does not invalidate the theorem or the surrounding argument. The corpus uses the corrected duality in [Robinson’s test](entries/model-completeness/entry.html#robinson-test).
